info.title: ball
info.description: Command-line tool for Ball, a programming language where every program is a Protocol Buffer message. Runs, compiles, encodes, and inspects Ball programs via the self-hosted C# engine and cli-core.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
Ball language CLI (C# toolchain): run/compile/encode/check/info/validate/tree/version.

NOTE on `run`: it drives the self-hosted engine, built in via the `SelfHost` MSBuild property (off by default — see csharp/engine/Ball.Engine.csproj). Without that property every program honestly reports a runtime error instead of silently doing nothing.

NOTE on `info`/`validate`/`tree`: they drive the self-hosted cli-core, built in via the `CliCore` MSBuild property (off by default — see csharp/cli/Ball.Cli.csproj). Without that property they honestly report a runtime error instead of silently doing nothing. `version` always works regardless of this property.

commands.name: run
commands.description: Execute a Ball program and print its stdout.

arguments.name: PROGRAM
arguments.description: Path to the program: .ball.json (proto3 JSON) or .ball.bin (binary protobuf).

commands.name: compile
commands.description: Compile a Ball program to C# source.

options.name: --output
options.description: Write the output here instead of stdout.

arguments.name: PROGRAM
arguments.description: Path to the program: .ball.json (proto3 JSON) or .ball.bin (binary protobuf).

commands.name: encode
commands.description: Encode a C# source file into a Ball program.

options.name: --output
options.description: Write the output here instead of stdout.

arguments.name: SOURCE
arguments.description: Path to the C# source file (.cs) to encode.

commands.name: check
commands.description: Parse and validate a Ball program without running it.

options.name: --compile
options.description: Additionally attempt a dry-run compile to C# (output discarded) — a stronger, C#-target-specific check. [default: False]

arguments.name: PROGRAM
arguments.description: Path to the program: .ball.json (proto3 JSON) or .ball.bin (binary protobuf).

commands.name: info
commands.description: Inspect a Ball program's structure (modules, functions, type defs).

arguments.name: PROGRAM
arguments.description: Path to the program: .ball.json (proto3 JSON) or .ball.bin (binary protobuf).

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Check a Ball program's validity (entry point, module/function shape).

arguments.name: PROGRAM
arguments.description: Path to the program: .ball.json (proto3 JSON) or .ball.bin (binary protobuf).

commands.name: tree
commands.description: Print a Ball program's module/import dependency tree.

arguments.name: PROGRAM
arguments.description: Path to the program: .ball.json (proto3 JSON) or .ball.bin (binary protobuf).
